map.交通事故、务工受伤等人身损害，估算医疗费、误工费、残疾赔偿金等合计。: For personal injury in a traffic accident or at work, estimate medical expenses, lost earnings and disability compensation in total.
map.残疾赔偿金按伤残等级系数 × 赔偿年限 × 城镇居民人均可支配收入。: Disability compensation = disability coefficient × number of years × per-capita disposable income of urban residents.
map.区分责任比例，交强险限额内不分责。: Liability is apportioned, but within the compulsory traffic insurance limits no apportionment applies.
Per-capita disposable income of urban residents ¥52,000 a year, age 40 giving 20 years, grade-10 coefficient 0.1: disability compensation = 52,000 × 20 × 0.1 = ¥104,000, plus medical expenses and lost earnings as actually incurred.
map.系数 1.0、同口径：死亡赔偿金 = 5.2万 × 20 × 1 = 1,040: Using the same basis with a coefficient of 1.0: death compensation = 52,000 × 20 × 1 = ¥1,040,000 for a person under 60, plus funeral expenses and dependants' living costs.
map.残疾赔偿金年限怎么定？: How are the years for disability compensation set?
map.60 周岁以下按 20 年；60 以上每增 1 岁减 1 年；75 岁以上按 5: 20 years under 60, one year less for each year of age above 60, and 5 years from age 75; the coefficient runs from 0.1 at grade 10 to 1.0 at grade 1.
map.算，计入残疾/死亡赔偿金一并主张；本工具提示未自动包含，需另行按被扶养人人数、年: Yes, they are claimed together with the disability or death compensation. This tool does not include them automatically, so they must be worked out separately from the number of dependants, the years and the coefficient.
map.人身损害赔偿计算器。法律合规工具，基于现行法律法规计算，数据本地处理。: Personal Injury Compensation Calculator. A legal compliance tool that computes under current laws and regulations, with all data processed locally.
map.人身损害赔偿估额（本页代码口径）：赔偿年限按年龄分段——年龄<60 取 20 年: Personal injury compensation estimate (actual code on this page): compensation years by age — age < 60 uses 20 years, 60 ≤ age < 75 uses 20 − (age − 60) years, ≥ 75 uses 5 years; compensation ratio = (11 − disability grade) ÷ 10 (grade 1 = 100%, grade 10 = 10%, no disability = 0, consistent with the judicial disability grading), death uses 100%; disability or death compensation = annual income × compensation years × compensation ratio; lost work pay = (monthly wage ÷ 30) × lost work days; nursing fee = nursing days × 150 (fixed 150 CNY/day); meal allowance = daily meal standard × hospital days; transport fixed at 1,000 CNY; funeral fee = local average monthly wage at death × 6; solatium = compensation ratio × 50,000 (fixed 50,000 CNY for death); total = sum of the eight items: medical, lost work, nursing, meals, transport, disability or death, funeral and solatium. Validation: no strict validation, empty values fall back to 0, and invalid results prompt to check the inputs. Rule: dependent living expenses, assistive devices, nutrition and follow-up treatment are not included, and local standards vary, so the result is for reference only.
